title: chore(pm-dispatch): drop the area-thread authorising line from area-lease

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9ByqhcEhGGLvFdPenzipR8D)_

Fixes #33971

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:区域租约「开席」第 3 步删掉区线程授权行「本区通过复审的 PR 都可以 ready + auto-merge」,只留席线程(Tier H)那句,并写明区线程无授权行;区内「落地」行加一句「受拒报原文」。
- 为什么改:您确认没有座位需要这句话,区线程的 PR 不靠它也照常合进去了;规则还写着它,新座位就会来找您要、把它当瓶颈上报。
- 风险与回滚:只改一份内部 PM 参考文档(净减 1 行),不碰代码与已发布内容;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md` 第 26–28 行(第 3 步)与第 44 行(落地行)。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n '本区通过复审' origin/main -- .claude` 合并后应无任何输出。
- 需要你做的:受管面 `.claude/**`,等席位达档复核 PASS 后由席位落地(若判 Tier H 则需您批准)。

## What changes

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md`, one file, +3 / -4 (59 lines, was 60):

1. 「开席」 step 3: the area-thread line 「本区通过复审的 PR 都可以 ready + auto-merge」 is removed. The step now opens 「维护者在每条新席线程亲写一句授权行」, keeps the seat-thread line 「审批人批准后的 Tier H PR 你可以自主落地」 unchanged (out of scope per the card), and keeps the bound 「授权行只解 auto mode 的拦截,⛔ 不改 AGENTS.md 第 14 条的落地档」, to which it appends 「区线程无授权行」 so no seat reads a missing line as a blocker.
2. Card change 3 lives on the in-area 落地 line, where the area thread's landing is described: 「非受管 PR 照 `landing-operations.md` 自落,受拒报原文」. A refused landing reports the refusal text; the step-3 sentence above says there is no area line to name instead. The seat-side refusal rule in `landing-operations.md` (classifier refusal: stop, report, record the command and refusal reason on the card) already covers seats and is not touched.

No line was bought by a re-wrap: the line count falls by the one deleted line, and the two additions ride existing lines inside the 120-byte budget (step 3 header 120 B, bound line 109 B, landing line 120 B).

## Tests

No test changes; documentation-only internal tooling. Gates below.

- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` reads area-lease.md at 59 lines. Review record 6897124418 (S1) asked for the ceiling row to follow it down: claim amendment 6897134113 widened the surface to `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (that row only), and head bffd9a15 lowers it 60 → 59 (headroom 0) and corrects its comment. On bffd9a15 the derived set widened to 37 commands, all exit 0, `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED; the gate table below is the 7dabaf6a run.
- `skip-changeset`: `.claude/**` only, nothing published.
